page_title: Item:Legendary Cowl of the Giant Warriors

enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Combat Mastery +5: +5 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Physical Sheltering +33: +33 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Insightful Deadly +4: +4 Insight bonus to weapon damage.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
